description: Request for the multi-engine safety portfolio endpoint (`POST /api/v1/btor2/verify`). Mirrors the CLI `mununu btor2 verify`: decides `bad`-reachability of a BTOR2 design across every available sound engine.

fault_warmup.description: Cycles before the first injection may fire (default 10). Mirrors `--fault-warmup`.

faults.description: Fault-injection posture (`"REG[:k]"`, one global budget, default 1): the design is rewritten as `btor2 inject-fault` does before the portfolio runs; `"violated"` then reads "an attack within the budget reaches `bad`". Mirrors the CLI `--fault`. Default empty.

title: Btor2VerifyRequest
